abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dermoid cysts are rarely located in extraovarian sites, representing an extremely uncommon lesion of the round ligament. The differential diagnosis of an inguinal lesion that proved to be a dermoid cyst deriving from the round ligament is presented with a review of the literature. CASE REPORT: A case of a 27-year-old female with a dermoid cyst arising from the round ligament and lying inside the inguinal canal, which was tender and palpable, is reported. DISCUSSION: Underlining their origin, clinical manifestation, gross appearance and pathology, we differentiate dermoid cysts mainly from epidermoid cysts and mature cystic teratomas, analyzing the importance of such a distinction to the possibility of malignant degeneration and recurrence of a dermoid cyst in the round ligament.
abstract_ja: はじめに：類皮嚢腫は卵巣外部位に発生することはまれであり、子宮円索の病変としては極めてまれである。鼠径部病変の鑑別診断を行い、子宮円索由来の類皮嚢腫と判明した症例について、文献レビューとともに報告する。症例報告：27歳女性で、鼠径管内に生じた圧痛を伴い触知可能な類皮嚢腫が認められた。考察：類皮嚢腫の起源、臨床像、肉眼所見、病理所見に注目し、類皮嚢腫を類表皮嚢腫や成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と区別して論じる。これらの区別は、悪性転化や子宮円索における類皮嚢腫の再発の可能性を考慮するうえで重要である。
